findings.title: Apply untrusted-field restrictions to website_name
findings.body: The new website_name attribute is not included in untrusted_attributes, so it is serialized even when scope.restrict_user_fields?(object) suppresses website for an anonymous viewer of a TL0 user. This exposes the otherwise-hidden website hostname (and path for same-domain URLs), and the updated template displays it because it checks website_name rather than website. The include_website_name method does not prevent this: it lacks the required '?' suffix and only checks presence anyway. Apply the same restriction used for website and extend the anonymous/TL0 serializer test to cover the new field.
